lead: Choose led ice bucket - rgb 7 colors by the model-specific material, dimensions and configuration below. Our factory team provides free design and a product visual mockup for your logo or artwork.

RGB seven-color lighting. The supplier sheet links the 4L, 8L and 12L body and packing versions to the corresponding single-color bucket bodies. Artwork on the Selected Product
